caption:
14 missing scientists & counting… PT. 2 Amy Eskridge & David Wilcock

#fyp #uap #disclosure #missing #scientists
video_overlay_text_observed: Cover card: "MISSING SCIENTISTS PT 2" over the same whiteboard; lines 13 and 14 cover David Wilcock and Amy Eskridge.
audio_content_summary: Covers David Wilcock's death and Amy Eskridge's, then relays Eskridge's own claims about directed-energy harassment, an anti-gravity breakthrough held back from release, and time-travelling 'ultraterrestrials'.
implied_frame: Frames both deaths as suppression rather than suicide. Unsupported assertions: that Eskridge 'proved out' the TR-3B gravitic craft in 2018 (her 2018 Huntsville L5 talk was a historical survey of electrogravitics claims, not an experimental result); that the TR-3B is a patented military craft; that anti-gravity has been discovered and buried four or five times, including by Ning Li (who died in 2021 of Alzheimer's after a 2014 pedestrian collision); that elites time-travel from timelines 47,000 and 52,000 years out; that Wilcock is the reincarnation of Edgar Cayce and channels 'blue avians'; that seven or eight Chinese scientists in the same fields have vanished in two years. Contested but real: Eskridge's texts to a former British intelligence officer, her Havana-syndrome and directed-energy claims, and Rep. Eric Burlison's public endorsement of them — her father, a retired NASA Marshall engineer, publicly rejects the conspiracy reading.
capture_method: Pristine original media + metadata pulled from Instagram's CDN via yt-dlp; delivery webm derived once (VP9 video copied, audio normalized to -16 LUFS / -1.5 dBTP off the source AAC — no re-recording, no in-place re-encode).
